resources.string: Choose ClockMorph designs in rows or place up to five anywhere on the lock screen. Replaces the device info widgets while enabled.
Soften the wallpaper behind widget cards
Choose widgets for either row to get started
Small widgets use one slot, wide widgets use two, and inline widgets fill a row. Remove a widget before reducing a full row from five slots to four.
Tap a design to add it to this row. Tap a selected design to remove it. Designs that do not fit are dimmed.
Place up to five widgets anywhere, including over the clock. The clock, notifications and other elements keep their positions. Your two-row layout is saved separately.
Drag a widget to move it. Select one below to adjust its size or position, or remove it. Preview uses sample data.
Add a widget, then drag it anywhere on the preview.
Choose a design to add to the preview. Up to five widgets can be placed independently.
